lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我昨天在捷運站叫了妳好幾聲，妳怎麼都沒看我？
lines.simplified: 我昨天在捷运站叫了你好几声，你怎么都没看我？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài jiéyùn zhàn jiào le nǐ hǎojǐ shēng, nǐ zěnme dōu méi kàn wǒ?
lines.english: Yesterday at the MRT station I called out to you several times. Why didn't you even look at me?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我昨天一整天都在家寫報告啊。你是不是把我妹妹看成我了？我們兩個長得很像。
lines.simplified: 我昨天一整天都在家写报告啊。你是不是把我妹妹看成我了？我们两个长得很像。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān yì zhěng tiān dōu zài jiā xiě bàogào a. Nǐ shì bú shì bǎ wǒ mèimei kàn chéng wǒ le? Wǒmen liǎng ge zhǎng de hěn xiàng.
lines.english: I was at home writing a report all day yesterday. Did you take my younger sister for me? We look a lot alike.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 難怪！那個人從頭到腳都是名牌，我還在想妳的穿著怎麼變了。
lines.simplified: 难怪！那个人从头到脚都是名牌，我还在想你的穿着怎么变了。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài! Nàge rén cóng tóu dào jiǎo dōu shì míngpái, wǒ hái zài xiǎng nǐ de chuānzhuó zěnme biàn le.
lines.english: No wonder! That person was in brand names from head to toe. I was wondering why your clothes had changed.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，她天天穿名牌，我就沒那麼講究了。
lines.simplified: 对，她天天穿名牌，我就没那么讲究了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, tā tiāntiān chuān míngpái, wǒ jiù méi nàme jiǎngjiù le.
lines.english: Right, she wears brand names every day; I'm not that fussy.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的昨天在捷運站發生了什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 男的昨天在捷运站发生了什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuótiān zài jiéyùn zhàn fāshēng le shénme shì?
prompt.english: What happened to the man at the MRT station yesterday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de bǎ tā kàn chéng le biérén.
choices.english: The woman took him for someone else.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的穿衣服的風格變了
choices.simplified: 女的穿衣服的风格变了
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de chuān yīfu de fēnggé biàn le.
choices.english: The woman's style of dress had changed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jiào de rén shì tā de jiějie.
choices.english: The person he called was her older sister.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jiào de rén bú shì nǚ de.
choices.english: The person he called was not the woman.

questions.why: 你是不是把我妹妹看成我了？ and his 難怪 confirm he took the sister for her: she was at home all day. It was he who mistook someone, not she who mistook him, and the look-alike is her younger sister (妹妹), not an older one; the changed style was only what the sister's brand names made him think.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你這個袋子好特別！在哪裡買的？
lines.simplified: 你这个袋子好特别！在哪里买的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhège dàizi hǎo tèbié! Zài nǎlǐ mǎi de?
lines.english: Your bag is so unusual! Where did you buy it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是買的，是我媽媽做的。她把我爸爸穿不下的舊牛仔褲改成了袋子。
lines.simplified: 不是买的，是我妈妈做的。她把我爸爸穿不下的旧牛仔裤改成了袋子。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì mǎi de, shì wǒ māma zuò de. Tā bǎ wǒ bàba chuān bú xià de jiù niúzǎikù gǎi chéng le dàizi.
lines.english: It's not bought, my mom made it. She turned an old pair of my dad's jeans that he can't fit into any more into a bag.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 穿不下了，為什麼不丟掉呢？
lines.simplified: 穿不下了，为什么不丢掉呢？
lines.pinyin: Chuān bú xià le, wèishénme bù diūdiào ne?
lines.english: If he can't fit into them, why not throw them away?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我媽媽本來也想丟掉，可是我爸爸說，那條褲子是他第一次跟我媽媽見面時穿的。她就上網看影片，學會了怎麼做。
lines.simplified: 我妈妈本来也想丢掉，可是我爸爸说，那条裤子是他第一次跟我妈妈见面时穿的。她就上网看影片，学会了怎么做。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ māma běnlái yě xiǎng diūdiào, kěshì wǒ bàba shuō, nà tiáo kùzi shì tā dì yī cì gēn wǒ māma jiànmiàn shí chuān de. Tā jiù shàngwǎng kàn yǐngpiàn, xué huì le zěnme zuò.
lines.english: My mom wanted to throw them away too, but my dad said those were the jeans he wore when he first met her. So she watched videos online and learned how to do it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 媽媽為什麼把那條褲子改成袋子？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈为什么把那条裤子改成袋子？
prompt.pinyin: Māma wèishénme bǎ nà tiáo kùzi gǎi chéng dàizi?
prompt.english: Why did the mother turn those trousers into a bag?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kùzi duì bàba hěn yǒu yìyì.
choices.english: The trousers mean a lot to the father.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ mài de dàizi tài guì le.
choices.english: Bags in the shops are too expensive.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bàba yǐhòu hái xiǎng zài chuān.
choices.english: The father wants to wear them again later.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng shìshi yǐngpiàn lǐ de zuòfǎ.
choices.english: She wanted to try a method from a video.

questions.why: She meant to throw the jeans out (本來也想丟掉), 可是 the father said he wore them when they first met, so she kept them as a bag. The videos are how she learned to do it, not why, and he can no longer fit into them (穿不下).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你開始上班以後，每天都得穿襯衫、皮鞋嗎？
lines.simplified: 你开始上班以后，每天都得穿衬衫、皮鞋吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kāishǐ shàngbān yǐhòu, měi tiān dōu děi chuān chènshān, píxié ma?
lines.english: Since you started work, do you have to wear a shirt and leather shoes every day?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，公司要大家穿得正式一點。我以前天天穿球鞋，剛開始真的穿不慣，走一天路，腳痛得不得了。
lines.simplified: 对啊，公司要大家穿得正式一点。我以前天天穿球鞋，刚开始真的穿不惯，走一天路，脚痛得不得了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, gōngsī yào dàjiā chuān de zhèngshì yìdiǎn. Wǒ yǐqián tiāntiān chuān qiúxié, gāng kāishǐ zhēn de chuān bú guàn, zǒu yì tiān lù, jiǎo tòng de bùdéliǎo.
lines.english: Yes, the company wants everyone to dress a bit formally. I used to wear sneakers every day, so at first I really couldn't get used to them; after a day of walking my feet hurt terribly.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你週末一定馬上換回球鞋吧？
lines.simplified: 那你周末一定马上换回球鞋吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ zhōumò yídìng mǎshàng huàn huí qiúxié ba?
lines.english: Then at weekends you must switch straight back to sneakers, right?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來是這樣。可是三個月下來，皮鞋我已經穿慣了，現在週末也常穿。
lines.simplified: 本来是这样。可是三个月下来，皮鞋我已经穿惯了，现在周末也常穿。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái shì zhèyàng. Kěshì sān ge yuè xiàlái, píxié wǒ yǐjīng chuān guàn le, xiànzài zhōumò yě cháng chuān.
lines.english: At first, yes. But after three months I'm used to leather shoes, and now I often wear them at weekends too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 跟剛開始上班的時候比，男的現在怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 跟刚开始上班的时候比，男的现在怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Gēn gāng kāishǐ shàngbān de shíhòu bǐ, nán de xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: Compared with when he first started work, how is the man now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 上班穿皮鞋，週末就換回球鞋
choices.simplified: 上班穿皮鞋，周末就换回球鞋
choices.pinyin: Shàngbān chuān píxié, zhōumò jiù huàn huí qiúxié.
choices.english: He wears leather shoes for work and switches back to sneakers at weekends.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿了一個月就穿慣了，週末也穿
choices.simplified: 穿了一个月就穿惯了，周末也穿
choices.pinyin: Chuān le yí ge yuè jiù chuān guàn le, zhōumò yě chuān.
choices.english: He got used to them within a month and wears them at weekends too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以前穿不慣的皮鞋，現在週末也穿
choices.simplified: 以前穿不惯的皮鞋，现在周末也穿
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián chuān bú guàn de píxié, xiànzài zhōumò yě chuān.
choices.english: He now wears the shoes he once could not get used to, even at weekends.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿慣皮鞋以後，週末也不想穿球鞋
choices.simplified: 穿惯皮鞋以后，周末也不想穿球鞋
choices.pinyin: Chuān guàn píxié yǐhòu, zhōumò yě bù xiǎng chuān qiúxié.
choices.english: Now he's used to leather shoes, he doesn't want to wear sneakers any more.

questions.why: 剛開始真的穿不慣 was the first weeks; 三個月下來，皮鞋我已經穿慣了，現在週末也常穿 is now. It took three months (三個月下來), not one, to get used to them; switching back at weekends was the woman's guess, which he answers with 本來是這樣 (that was only at first), and he never says he dislikes sneakers now.

focus.zh: V 不慣 → V 慣了

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我打算下個月搬出宿舍，在學校附近租房子。
lines.simplified: 我打算下个月搬出宿舍，在学校附近租房子。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dǎsuàn xià ge yuè bān chū sùshè, zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū fángzi.
lines.english: I'm planning to move out of the dorm next month and rent a place near school.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是因為妳睡不慣宿舍的床嗎？妳上次說床太小，睡不好。
lines.simplified: 是因为你睡不惯宿舍的床吗？你上次说床太小，睡不好。
lines.pinyin: Shì yīnwèi nǐ shuì bú guàn sùshè de chuáng ma? Nǐ shàng cì shuō chuáng tài xiǎo, shuì bù hǎo.
lines.english: Is it because you can't get used to the dorm bed? Last time you said the bed was too small and you couldn't sleep well.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那是剛搬進去的時候。現在那張床我已經睡得慣了。
lines.simplified: 那是刚搬进去的时候。现在那张床我已经睡得惯了。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì gāng bān jìnqù de shíhòu. Xiànzài nà zhāng chuáng wǒ yǐjīng shuì de guàn le.
lines.english: That was when I first moved in. I'm used to sleeping in that bed now.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那是為什麼？
lines.simplified: 那是为什么？
lines.pinyin: Nà shì wèishénme?
lines.english: Then why?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我室友最近每天半夜都在講電話，一講就講到兩、三點。
lines.simplified: 我室友最近每天半夜都在讲电话，一讲就讲到两、三点。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu zuìjìn měi tiān bànyè dōu zài jiǎng diànhuà, yì jiǎng jiù jiǎng dào liǎng, sān diǎn.
lines.english: Lately my roommate is on the phone every night after midnight, and once she starts she goes on until two or three.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的本來以為女的為什麼要搬出宿舍？
prompt.simplified: 男的本来以为女的为什么要搬出宿舍？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de běnlái yǐwéi nǚ de wèishénme yào bān chū sùshè?
prompt.english: Why did the man at first think the woman was moving out of the dorm?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng zhù de lí xuéxiào jìn yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She wants to live closer to school.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她還是睡不習慣宿舍的床
choices.simplified: 她还是睡不习惯宿舍的床
choices.pinyin: Tā háishì shuì bù xíguàn sùshè de chuáng.
choices.english: She still isn't used to the dorm bed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu bànyè chángcháng jiǎng diànhuà.
choices.english: Her roommate is often on the phone at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bù xíguàn gēn biérén yìqǐ zhù.
choices.english: She isn't used to sharing a room.

questions.why: He guessed the old problem (妳睡不慣宿舍的床嗎？), but she says that was only at first: 現在那張床我已經睡得慣了 (睡得慣 = can sleep there and is used to it). The phone calls are her real reason, not what he thought, and living near school is where she will move, not why.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你發燒了，下午的課還是別去了吧。
lines.simplified: 你发烧了，下午的课还是别去了吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ fāshāo le, xiàwǔ de kè háishì bié qù le ba.
lines.english: You've got a fever. You'd better not go to your afternoon class.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 別的課不去沒關係，可是下午那堂課要報告，我非去不可。
lines.simplified: 别的课不去没关系，可是下午那堂课要报告，我非去不可。
lines.pinyin: Bié de kè bú qù méi guānxi, kěshì xiàwǔ nà táng kè yào bàogào, wǒ fēi qù bù kě.
lines.english: Missing other classes is fine, but this afternoon's class has a presentation. I have to go.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你把資料寄給同學，請他們替你報告，不行嗎？
lines.simplified: 你把资料寄给同学，请他们替你报告，不行吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ zīliào jì gěi tóngxué, qǐng tāmen tì nǐ bàogào, bù xíng ma?
lines.english: Can't you send your material to your classmates and ask them to present for you?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 老師說每個人都得自己報告，沒來的人，這次報告就算零分。
lines.simplified: 老师说每个人都得自己报告，没来的人，这次报告就算零分。
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō měi ge rén dōu děi zìjǐ bàogào, méi lái de rén, zhè cì bàogào jiù suàn líng fēn.
lines.english: The teacher said everyone has to present in person; anyone who doesn't come gets zero for this presentation.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的建議請同學替他報告，男的為什麼說不行？
prompt.simplified: 女的建议请同学替他报告，男的为什么说不行？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiànyì qǐng tóngxué tì tā bàogào, nán de wèishénme shuō bù xíng?
prompt.english: The woman suggests classmates present for him. Why does the man say that won't work?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那堂課要考試，不能請假
choices.simplified: 那堂课要考试，不能请假
choices.pinyin: Nà táng kè yào kǎoshì, bù néng qǐngjià.
choices.english: There's a test in that class, so he can't miss it.

choices.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 老师要每个人亲自报告
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī yào měi ge rén qīnzì bàogào.
choices.english: The teacher wants everyone to present in person.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 資料得當天親自交給老師
choices.simplified: 资料得当天亲自交给老师
choices.pinyin: Zīliào děi dàngtiān qīnzì jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
choices.english: The material must be handed to the teacher in person that day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 沒去的人得多寫一份報告
choices.simplified: 没去的人得多写一份报告
choices.pinyin: Méi qù de rén děi duō xiě yí fèn bàogào.
choices.english: Anyone absent must write an extra report.

questions.why: She suggests classmates present for him, but 老師說每個人都得自己報告, so 非去不可. Absent students get zero for this presentation, not an extra report, and it is a presentation, not a test.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這家牛肉麵店要排一個小時，我們換一家吧？
lines.simplified: 这家牛肉面店要排一个小时，我们换一家吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā niúròu miàn diàn yào pái yí ge xiǎoshí, wǒmen huàn yì jiā ba?
lines.english: There's an hour's queue at this beef noodle place. Shall we try another one?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不行，我朋友說來臺北非吃這家不可，我已經想了一個月了。
lines.simplified: 不行，我朋友说来台北非吃这家不可，我已经想了一个月了。
lines.pinyin: Bù xíng, wǒ péngyǒu shuō lái Táiběi fēi chī zhè jiā bù kě, wǒ yǐjīng xiǎng le yí ge yuè le.
lines.english: No way. My friend said if you come to Taipei you absolutely have to eat here. I've been thinking about it for a month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是我們的火車四點就開了，現在已經兩點半了。
lines.simplified: 可是我们的火车四点就开了，现在已经两点半了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒmen de huǒchē sì diǎn jiù kāi le, xiànzài yǐjīng liǎng diǎn bàn le.
lines.english: But our train leaves at four, and it's already half past two.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那這樣吧，妳先去車站把票買好，我在這裡排隊，吃完馬上過去找妳。
lines.simplified: 那这样吧，你先去车站把票买好，我在这里排队，吃完马上过去找你。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhèyàng ba, nǐ xiān qù chēzhàn bǎ piào mǎi hǎo, wǒ zài zhèlǐ páiduì, chī wán mǎshàng guòqù zhǎo nǐ.
lines.english: Then how about this: you go to the station first and buy the tickets, I'll queue here, and as soon as I've eaten I'll come and find you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，那也幫我買一碗帶走。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那也帮我买一碗带走。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà yě bāng wǒ mǎi yì wǎn dài zǒu.
lines.english: All right. Then get me a bowl to take away as well.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 男的为什么要女的先去车站？

prompt.english: Why does the man want the woman to go to the station first?

choices.traditional: 他不換店，一起排又怕來不及
choices.simplified: 他不换店，一起排又怕来不及
choices.pinyin: Tā bú huàn diàn, yìqǐ pái yòu pà láibùjí.
choices.english: He won't change places, but queuing together may make them late.

questions.why: 非吃這家不可 rules out another shop, and the hour-long queue against a four o'clock train means waiting together is too risky, so they split up. Changing shops was her first idea, not a plan for the station, and nobody says the tickets are selling out.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我上個星期才買的手機，昨天就壞了。
lines.simplified: 我上个星期才买的手机，昨天就坏了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàng ge xīngqí cái mǎi de shǒujī, zuótiān jiù huài le.
lines.english: I only bought my phone last week, and yesterday it already broke.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這麼說，妳可以拿回去換一支新的吧？
lines.simplified: 这么说，你可以拿回去换一支新的吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, nǐ kěyǐ ná huíqù huàn yì zhī xīn de ba?
lines.english: So you can take it back and swap it for a new one, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我也這麼以為，可是店員說得先送回去檢查，要是修不好，才能換新的。
lines.simplified: 我也这么以为，可是店员说得先送回去检查，要是修不好，才能换新的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème yǐwéi, kěshì diànyuán shuō děi xiān sòng huíqù jiǎnchá, yàoshì xiū bù hǎo, cái néng huàn xīn de.
lines.english: That's what I thought, but the clerk said it first has to be sent back to be checked, and only if they can't fix it can I get a new one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那要等多久？
lines.simplified: 那要等多久？
lines.pinyin: Nà yào děng duō jiǔ?
lines.english: How long do you have to wait?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大概兩個星期。這兩個星期，我只好先用我哥哥的舊手機了。
lines.simplified: 大概两个星期。这两个星期，我只好先用我哥哥的旧手机了。
lines.pinyin: Dàgài liǎng ge xīngqí. Zhè liǎng ge xīngqí, wǒ zhǐhǎo xiān yòng wǒ gēge de jiù shǒujī le.
lines.english: About two weeks. For those two weeks I'll have to use my brother's old phone.

prompt.simplified: 这支手机，店员怎么说？

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個週末我們不是要去山上露營嗎？東西我都準備好了。
lines.simplified: 这个周末我们不是要去山上露营吗？东西我都准备好了。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒmen bú shì yào qù shān shàng lùyíng ma? Dōngxi wǒ dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
lines.english: Aren't we going camping in the mountains this weekend? I've got everything ready.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 氣象預報說星期六會有颱風，我們還是改到下個星期六吧。
lines.simplified: 气象预报说星期六会有台风，我们还是改到下个星期六吧。
lines.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō xīngqíliù huì yǒu táifēng, wǒmen háishì gǎi dào xià ge xīngqíliù ba.
lines.english: The weather forecast says a typhoon is coming on Saturday. We'd better move it to next Saturday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我以為這個颱風不會到北部，沒想到還是會來。那星期天去呢？
lines.simplified: 我以为这个台风不会到北部，没想到还是会来。那星期天去呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi zhège táifēng bú huì dào běibù, méixiǎngdào háishì huì lái. Nà xīngqítiān qù ne?
lines.english: I thought this typhoon wouldn't reach the north, but it's coming after all. What about going on Sunday?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 預報說星期天雨還是很大，山路可能會很危險。
lines.simplified: 预报说星期天雨还是很大，山路可能会很危险。
lines.pinyin: Yùbào shuō xīngqítiān yǔ háishì hěn dà, shānlù kěnéng huì hěn wéixiǎn.
lines.english: The forecast says it'll still be raining hard on Sunday. The mountain roads could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，那就聽妳的。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那就听你的。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà jiù tīng nǐ de.
lines.english: All right, we'll do it your way.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們決定什麼時候去露營？
prompt.simplified: 他们决定什么时候去露营？

prompt.english: When do they decide to go camping?

questions.why: 她說還是改到下個星期六吧, which is next weekend; his Sunday idea is ruled out by the rain, and 那就聽妳的 goes back to her plan. Saturday is the typhoon day.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你下個星期要去女朋友家見她爸媽，衣服準備好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你下个星期要去女朋友家见她爸妈，衣服准备好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xià ge xīngqí yào qù nǚpéngyǒu jiā jiàn tā bàmā, yīfu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
lines.english: Next week you're going to your girlfriend's home to meet her parents. Have you got your clothes ready?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還沒。我想去百貨公司買一套名牌的，聽說她爸媽對穿著很講究。
lines.simplified: 还没。我想去百货公司买一套名牌的，听说她爸妈对穿着很讲究。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi. Wǒ xiǎng qù bǎihuò gōngsī mǎi yí tào míngpái de, tīngshuō tā bàmā duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiù.
lines.english: Not yet. I want to buy a brand-name outfit at a department store. I hear her parents are very particular about clothes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我覺得不必。她爸媽想認識的是你這個人，不是你的衣服。況且你上個月才買了一件深藍色的外套，穿那件就很好看了。
lines.simplified: 我觉得不必。她爸妈想认识的是你这个人，不是你的衣服。况且你上个月才买了一件深蓝色的外套，穿那件就很好看了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde búbì. Tā bàmā xiǎng rènshì de shì nǐ zhège rén, bú shì nǐ de yīfu. Kuàngqiě nǐ shàng ge yuè cái mǎi le yí jiàn shēn lánsè de wàitào, chuān nà jiàn jiù hěn hǎokàn le.
lines.english: I don't think you need to. Her parents want to get to know you, not your clothes. Besides, you only bought a dark blue jacket last month; you look great in that.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是那件是平價的，不是名牌啊。
lines.simplified: 可是那件是平价的，不是名牌啊。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nà jiàn shì píngjià de, bú shì míngpái a.
lines.english: But that one's cheap, it's not a brand name.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那又怎麼樣？你平時不穿那麼正式的衣服，突然穿得太正式，自己也會不自在。
lines.simplified: 那又怎么样？你平时不穿那么正式的衣服，突然穿得太正式，自己也会不自在。
lines.pinyin: Nà yòu zěnmeyàng? Nǐ píngshí bù chuān nàme zhèngshì de yīfu, túrán chuān de tài zhèngshì, zìjǐ yě huì bú zìzài.
lines.english: So what? You don't normally wear such formal clothes. If you suddenly dress too formally, you won't feel at ease yourself.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也對。畢竟是第一次見面，讓他們看到平常的我，比穿名牌重要。
lines.simplified: 也对。毕竟是第一次见面，让他们看到平常的我，比穿名牌重要。
lines.pinyin: Yě duì. Bìjìng shì dì yī cì jiànmiàn, ràng tāmen kàndào píngcháng de wǒ, bǐ chuān míngpái zhòngyào.
lines.english: True. After all, it's the first time we meet; letting them see me as I usually am matters more than wearing brand names.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼覺得男的不必買新衣服？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么觉得男的不必买新衣服？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme juéde nán de búbì mǎi xīn yīfu?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the man doesn't need to buy new clothes?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他已經有一件合適的外套
choices.simplified: 他已经有一件合适的外套
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng yǒu yí jiàn héshì de wàitào.
choices.english: He already has a suitable jacket.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 百貨公司的名牌太貴了
choices.simplified: 百货公司的名牌太贵了
choices.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī de míngpái tài guì le.
choices.english: Brand names at department stores are too expensive.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女朋友的爸媽不喜歡名牌
choices.simplified: 女朋友的爸妈不喜欢名牌
choices.pinyin: Nǚpéngyǒu de bàmā bù xǐhuān míngpái.
choices.english: His girlfriend's parents don't like brand names.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他穿正式的衣服不好看
choices.simplified: 他穿正式的衣服不好看
choices.pinyin: Tā chuān zhèngshì de yīfu bù hǎokàn.
choices.english: He doesn't look good in formal clothes.

questions.why: Her reasons are that the parents want to know him, not his clothes, and 況且 adds that last month's dark blue jacket already looks good. She never says the parents dislike brand names, and her worry about formal clothes is that he won't feel at ease, not that he looks bad.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 第一次見女朋友的爸媽，男的最後覺得什麼最重要？
prompt.simplified: 第一次见女朋友的爸妈，男的最后觉得什么最重要？
prompt.pinyin: Dì yī cì jiàn nǚpéngyǒu de bàmā, nán de zuìhòu juéde shénme zuì zhòngyào?
prompt.english: For the first meeting with his girlfriend's parents, what does the man finally think matters most?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chuān de gòu zhèngshì, cái yǒu lǐmào.
choices.english: Dressing formally enough, to be polite.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zuò zìjǐ, chuān de zìrán jiù hǎo.
choices.english: Being himself and dressing naturally.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿得跟女朋友爸媽一樣講究
choices.simplified: 穿得跟女朋友爸妈一样讲究
choices.pinyin: Chuān de gēn nǚpéngyǒu bàmā yíyàng jiǎngjiù.
choices.english: Dressing as carefully as her parents do.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先了解他們喜歡的風格
choices.simplified: 先了解他们喜欢的风格
choices.pinyin: Xiān liǎojiě tāmen xǐhuān de fēnggé.
choices.english: Finding out first what style they like.

questions.why: 畢竟是第一次見面 leads to his conclusion: letting them see 平常的我 (being himself, dressed as usual) matters more than brand names. Matching the parents' fussiness and dressing up were his worries before she talked him round, and nobody suggests asking about their taste.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳又上網買衣服了？這個月已經第三次了吧。
lines.simplified: 你又上网买衣服了？这个月已经第三次了吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yòu shàngwǎng mǎi yīfu le? Zhège yuè yǐjīng dì sān cì le ba.
lines.english: Buying clothes online again? That's the third time this month, isn't it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這家的衣服很平價，一件才兩百塊，不買太可惜了。
lines.simplified: 这家的衣服很平价，一件才两百块，不买太可惜了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā de yīfu hěn píngjià, yí jiàn cái liǎngbǎi kuài, bù mǎi tài kěxí le.
lines.english: This shop's clothes are cheap, only two hundred each. It'd be a shame not to buy.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是妳的櫃子已經放不下了。況且上次買的那幾件，妳連一次都還沒穿過。
lines.simplified: 可是你的柜子已经放不下了。况且上次买的那几件，你连一次都还没穿过。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ de guìzi yǐjīng fàng bú xià le. Kuàngqiě shàng cì mǎi de nà jǐ jiàn, nǐ lián yí cì dōu hái méi chuān guo.
lines.english: But your wardrobe is already full. Besides, you haven't worn the ones you bought last time even once.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那是因為天氣還不夠冷，那幾件都是毛衣啊。
lines.simplified: 那是因为天气还不够冷，那几件都是毛衣啊。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì yīnwèi tiānqì hái bú gòu lěng, nà jǐ jiàn dōu shì máoyī a.
lines.english: That's because it isn't cold enough yet. They're all sweaters.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 等天氣冷了，又會有新的樣式出來，妳一定又想買新的。畢竟妳還是學生，錢要花在真正需要的地方。
lines.simplified: 等天气冷了，又会有新的样式出来，你一定又想买新的。毕竟你还是学生，钱要花在真正需要的地方。
lines.pinyin: Děng tiānqì lěng le, yòu huì yǒu xīn de yàngshì chūlái, nǐ yídìng yòu xiǎng mǎi xīn de. Bìjìng nǐ hái shì xuéshēng, qián yào huā zài zhēnzhèng xūyào de dìfāng.
lines.english: When it gets cold, new styles will come out again and you'll want new ones. After all, you're still a student; money should go on what you really need.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，這件我先不買了。等我把那幾件毛衣穿過了，再決定要不要買。
lines.simplified: 好吧，这件我先不买了。等我把那几件毛衣穿过了，再决定要不要买。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, zhè jiàn wǒ xiān bù mǎi le. Děng wǒ bǎ nà jǐ jiàn máoyī chuān guo le, zài juédìng yào bú yào mǎi.
lines.english: All right, I won't buy this one for now. Once I've worn those sweaters, I'll decide whether to buy it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的提到上次買的那幾件衣服，是想說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的提到上次买的那几件衣服，是想说什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de tí dào shàng cì mǎi de nà jǐ jiàn yīfu, shì xiǎng shuō shénme?
prompt.english: What is the man getting at when he mentions the clothes she bought last time?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那幾件的樣式已經不流行了
choices.simplified: 那几件的样式已经不流行了
choices.pinyin: Nà jǐ jiàn de yàngshì yǐjīng bù liúxíng le.
choices.english: Those clothes are already out of fashion.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà jǐ jiàn gēn zhè jiàn hěn xiàng.

choices.english: Those clothes can only be worn when it is cold.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女的買了衣服也不一定穿
choices.simplified: 女的买了衣服也不一定穿
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de mǎi le yīfu yě bù yídìng chuān.
choices.english: Buying clothes doesn't mean she will wear them.

questions.why: 況且 adds a second reason to stop buying: even last time's clothes have not been worn once, so buying does not mean wearing. Needing cold weather is her excuse, not his point, and he does not compare them with this one or call them out of fashion.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「畢竟妳還是學生」，是想告訴她什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「毕竟你还是学生」，是想告诉她什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō “bìjìng nǐ hái shì xuéshēng”, shì xiǎng gàosu tā shénme?
prompt.english: When the man says "after all, you're still a student", what is he telling her?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 時間應該多花在念書上
choices.simplified: 时间应该多花在念书上
choices.pinyin: Shíjiān yīnggāi duō huā zài niànshū shàng.
choices.english: Her time should go more on studying.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 學生穿平價的衣服就夠了
choices.simplified: 学生穿平价的衣服就够了
choices.pinyin: Xuéshēng chuān píngjià de yīfu jiù gòu le.
choices.english: Cheap clothes are good enough for a student.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 別亂花錢，買需要的就好
choices.simplified: 别乱花钱，买需要的就好
choices.pinyin: Bié luàn huā qián, mǎi xūyào de jiù hǎo.
choices.english: Don't waste money; buy only what she needs.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 別買平價的，買好一點的
choices.simplified: 别买平价的，买好一点的
choices.pinyin: Bié mǎi píngjià de, mǎi hǎo yìdiǎn de.
choices.english: Skip the cheap ones; buy better ones.

questions.why: 畢竟 brings in the key fact: as a student, 錢要花在真正需要的地方. He is talking about money, not study time. He never tells her to buy better, dearer clothes instead, nor says cheap clothes are fine: he wants her to stop buying what she does not need.

Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ jiù búzài luàn mǎi yīfu le. Xiànzài mǎi yīfu yǐqián, wǒ huì xiān xiǎng yì xiǎng zìjǐ shì bú shì zhēn de xūyào. Zài piányí de yīfu, mǎi duō le yě yào huā bù shǎo qián. Kuàngqiě yīfu tài duō, měi tiān zǎoshàng xuǎn yīfu yě yào huā hěn duō shíjiān. Wǒ hái xué huì le zìjǐ bǎ jiù yīfu gǎi chéng xīn de yàngshì, chuān qǐlái hěn yǒu zìjǐ de fēnggé. Péngyǒu dōu shuō, wǒ bǐ yǐqián gèng yǒu pǐnwèi le. Wǒ juéde yīfu búbì duō, bìjìng chuān de shūshì, zìzài cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.

From then on I stopped buying clothes on impulse. Now, before I buy anything, I first think about whether I really need it. However cheap clothes are, buy a lot and it still costs a fair bit. Besides, with too many clothes, choosing what to wear every morning takes ages. I have also learned to alter old clothes into new styles myself, and they look like my own style. My friends all say I have better taste than before. I think you don't need many clothes; after all, being comfortable and at ease in them is what matters most.

text.traditional: 我爺爺今年八十歲了，對穿著還是很講究。不管去哪裡，他一定穿襯衫和皮鞋，連去樓下買報紙也一樣。我小時候覺得很奇怪，問他為什麼不穿得輕鬆一點。他說，他年輕的時候家裡很窮，只有一件好襯衫，每次去找工作都穿那一件。有一次，一家公司的老闆對他說：「衣服舊沒關係，乾淨就好。穿得很乾淨，就看得出來你重視這份工作。」後來，他在那家公司工作了四十年。爺爺說，穿著跟有沒有錢無關，是對別人的禮貌。現在他的衣服都不是名牌，有的已經穿了二十年，可是每一件都洗得很乾淨。去年我大學畢業，第一次去找工作，爺爺送了我一條他最喜歡的皮帶，還說：「衣服再貴，人不認真也沒有用。」

Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu juéde hěn qíguài, wèn tā wèishénme bù chuān de qīngsōng yìdiǎn. Tā shuō, tā niánqīng de shíhòu jiālǐ hěn qióng, zhǐyǒu yí jiàn hǎo chènshān, měi cì qù zhǎo gōngzuò dōu chuān nà yí jiàn. Yǒu yí cì, yì jiā gōngsī de lǎobǎn duì tā shuō: “Yīfu jiù méi guānxi, gānjìng jiù hǎo. Chuān de hěn gānjìng, jiù kàn de chūlái nǐ zhòngshì zhè fèn gōngzuò.” Hòulái, tā zài nà jiā gōngsī gōngzuò le sìshí nián. Yéye shuō, chuānzhuó gēn yǒu méi yǒu qián wúguān, shì duì biérén de lǐmào. text.english: My grandfather is eighty this year and is still very particular about clothes. Wherever he goes he wears a shirt and leather shoes, even to buy a newspaper downstairs. As a child I found this strange and asked him why he didn't dress more casually. He said that when he was young his family was poor; he had only one good shirt and wore it every time he went looking for work. Once, a company boss told him, "It doesn't matter that your clothes are old, as long as they're clean. Dressed neatly and clean, anyone can see you take this job seriously." He went on to work at that company for forty years. Grandpa says dressing has nothing to do with money; it is courtesy towards others. None of his clothes are brand names, and some he has worn for twenty years, but every piece is washed spotless. Last year I graduated from university and went for my first job hunt. Grandpa gave me his favorite belt and said, "However expensive your clothes, they're no use if you aren't serious."

text.traditional: 我在一家賣快時尚衣服的店打工已經一年了。我們店裡每兩個星期就會換一次新樣式，衣服也很平價，所以很多年輕人一有空就來逛，一次買好幾件。剛開始我也跟他們一樣，打工的錢有一半都花在店裡的衣服上。後來我發現，很多客人買了衣服，過了幾個星期又來買新的，因為那件穿了一、兩次就不流行了。老闆說，這種現象在學生中最多。我開始想，流行變得這麼快，買再多也趕不上。現在我每次想買衣服，就會先問自己：「這件我非買不可嗎？」一個月下來，我只買了一雙襪子。同事開玩笑說，要是客人都像我一樣，老闆一定很頭痛。
text.simplified: 我在一家卖快时尚衣服的店打工已经一年了。我们店里每两个星期就会换一次新样式，衣服也很平价，所以很多年轻人一有空就来逛，一次买好几件。刚开始我也跟他们一样，打工的钱有一半都花在店里的衣服上。后来我发现，很多客人买了衣服，过了几个星期又来买新的，因为那件穿了一、两次就不流行了。老板说，这种现象在学生中最多。我开始想，流行变得这么快，买再多也赶不上。现在我每次想买衣服，就会先问自己：「这件我非买不可吗？」一个月下来，我只买了一双袜子。同事开玩笑说，要是客人都像我一样，老板一定很头痛。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài yì jiā mài kuàishíshàng yīfu de diàn dǎgōng yǐjīng yì nián le. Wǒmen diàn lǐ měi liǎng ge xīngqí jiù huì huàn yí cì xīn yàngshì, yīfu yě hěn píngjià, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng rén yì yǒu kòng jiù lái guàng, yí cì mǎi hǎojǐ jiàn. Gāng kāishǐ wǒ yě gēn tāmen yíyàng, dǎgōng de qián yǒu yíbàn dōu huā zài diàn lǐ de yīfu shàng. Hòulái wǒ fāxiàn, hěn duō kèrén mǎi le yīfu, guò le jǐ ge xīngqí yòu lái mǎi xīn de, yīnwèi nà jiàn chuān le yì, liǎng cì jiù bù liúxíng le. Lǎobǎn shuō, zhè zhǒng xiànxiàng zài xuéshēng zhōng zuì duō. Wǒ kāishǐ xiǎng, liúxíng biàn de zhème kuài, mǎi zài duō yě gǎn bú shàng. Xiànzài wǒ měi cì xiǎng mǎi yīfu, jiù huì xiān wèn zìjǐ: “Zhè jiàn wǒ fēi mǎi bù kě ma?” Yí ge yuè xiàlái, wǒ zhǐ mǎi le yì shuāng wàzi. Tóngshì kāi wánxiào shuō, yàoshì kèrén dōu xiàng wǒ yíyàng, lǎobǎn yídìng hěn tóutòng.
text.english: I've worked part-time at a fast-fashion clothing shop for a year. Our shop brings in new styles every two weeks, and the clothes are cheap, so lots of young people come browsing whenever they're free and buy several pieces at a time. At first I was just like them: half of what I earned went on clothes from the shop. Then I noticed many customers come back a few weeks after buying clothes to buy new ones, because what they bought is out of fashion after being worn once or twice. The boss says this happens most among students. I started to think: fashion changes so fast that however much you buy, you'll never keep up. Now whenever I want to buy something, I first ask myself, "Do I absolutely have to buy this?" After a month, I'd bought just one pair of socks. A coworker joked that if all customers were like me, the boss would have a real headache.

text.traditional: 去年夏天，我一個人去臺東當背包客。出發以前，我在很多部落格上看了詳細的介紹，把每天要去的景點都安排好了。沒想到第二天，我就在一個偏僻的山區迷路了。那裡的手機訊號很弱，連地圖都打不開，我只好站在路邊等車。過了快一個小時，一位阿姨開車經過，不僅把我送到了車站，還請我吃了她自己做的包子。那天晚上，我把這件事寫進了日記。回來以後，我在部落格上寫：「旅行前做好準備當然重要，話說回來，旅行中最難忘的，常常是計畫以外的事。」
text.simplified: 去年夏天，我一个人去台东当背包客。出发以前，我在很多部落格上看了详细的介绍，把每天要去的景点都安排好了。没想到第二天，我就在一个偏僻的山区迷路了。那里的手机讯号很弱，连地图都打不开，我只好站在路边等车。过了快一个小时，一位阿姨开车经过，不仅把我送到了车站，还请我吃了她自己做的包子。那天晚上，我把这件事写进了日记。回来以后，我在部落格上写：「旅行前做好准备当然重要，话说回来，旅行中最难忘的，常常是计画以外的事。」
text.pinyin: Qùnián xiàtiān, wǒ yí ge rén qù Táidōng dāng bēibāokè. Chūfā yǐqián, wǒ zài hěn duō bùluògé shàng kàn le xiángxì de jièshào, bǎ měi tiān yào qù de jǐngdiǎn dōu ānpái hǎo le. Méixiǎngdào dì èr tiān, wǒ jiù zài yí ge piānpì de shānqū mílù le. Nàlǐ de shǒujī xùnhào hěn ruò, lián dìtú dōu dǎ bù kāi, wǒ zhǐhǎo zhàn zài lùbiān děng chē. Guò le kuài yí ge xiǎoshí, yí wèi āyí kāichē jīngguò, bùjǐn bǎ wǒ sòng dào le chēzhàn, hái qǐng wǒ chī le tā zìjǐ zuò de bāozi. Nà tiān wǎnshàng, wǒ bǎ zhè jiàn shì xiě jìn le rìjì. Huílái yǐhòu, wǒ zài bùluògé shàng xiě: “Lǚxíng qián zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi dāngrán zhòngyào, huà shuō huílái, lǚxíng zhōng zuì nánwàng de, chángcháng shì jìhuà yǐwài de shì.”
text.english: Last summer I went backpacking alone in Taitung. Before I left, I read detailed write-ups on lots of blogs and planned the sights for every day. But on the second day I got lost in a remote mountain area. The phone signal there was so weak that I couldn't even open a map, so I had to stand by the road and wait for a car. After almost an hour, a woman drove past; she not only took me to the station but also gave me some buns she had made herself. That night I wrote it all down in my diary. When I got back, I wrote on my blog: "Preparing before a trip matters, of course. Then again, what you remember most from a trip is often what wasn't in the plan."

text.traditional: 我姊姊上個月生了一對雙胞胎。我本來以為照顧孩子只要餵奶就好，沒想到兩個孩子常常是一個剛睡著，一個又開始哭，而且一哭就哭個不停。姊姊一連好幾天都沒睡好。後來我每天下課就去姊姊家幫忙，抱抱他們、陪他們玩，讓姊姊能休息一下。我還學會了怎麼幫他們洗澡。滿月那天，姊姊請家人和朋友吃油飯和紅蛋，大家都說兩個孩子長得太像了，看不出誰是哥哥、誰是弟弟，只有我一看就知道。姊姊開玩笑說：「這麼說，你比我這個做媽媽的還清楚呢！」
text.simplified: 我姐姐上个月生了一对双胞胎。我本来以为照顾孩子只要喂奶就好，没想到两个孩子常常是一个刚睡着，一个又开始哭，而且一哭就哭个不停。姐姐一连好几天都没睡好。后来我每天下课就去姐姐家帮忙，抱抱他们、陪他们玩，让姐姐能休息一下。我还学会了怎么帮他们洗澡。满月那天，姐姐请家人和朋友吃油饭和红蛋，大家都说两个孩子长得太像了，看不出谁是哥哥、谁是弟弟，只有我一看就知道。姐姐开玩笑说：「这么说，你比我这个做妈妈的还清楚呢！」
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shàng ge yuè shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi. Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi zhàogù háizi zhǐyào wèi nǎi jiù hǎo, méixiǎngdào liǎng ge háizi chángcháng shì yí ge gāng shuìzháo, yí ge yòu kāishǐ kū, érqiě yì kū jiù kū ge bù tíng. Jiějie yìlián hǎojǐ tiān dōu méi shuì hǎo. Hòulái wǒ měi tiān xiàkè jiù qù jiějie jiā bāngmáng, bàobao tāmen, péi tāmen wán, ràng jiějie néng xiūxí yíxià. Wǒ hái xué huì le zěnme bāng tāmen xǐzǎo. Mǎnyuè nà tiān, jiějie qǐng jiārén hé péngyǒu chī yóufàn hé hóngdàn, dàjiā dōu shuō liǎng ge háizi zhǎng de tài xiàng le, kàn bù chū shéi shì gēge, shéi shì dìdi, zhǐyǒu wǒ yí kàn jiù zhīdào. Jiějie kāi wánxiào shuō: “Zhème shuō, nǐ bǐ wǒ zhège zuò māma de hái qīngchǔ ne!”
text.english: Last month my older sister had twins. I thought looking after babies was just a matter of feeding them, but often one would just fall asleep when the other started crying, and once they started they wouldn't stop. My sister didn't sleep well for days on end. So every day after class I went to her place to help: holding them and playing with them so she could rest a little. I even learned how to bathe them. At the full-month celebration, she treated family and friends to sticky rice and red eggs. Everyone said the two babies looked so alike they couldn't tell which was the older and which the younger; only I knew at a glance. My sister joked, "So you know them better than I do, and I'm their mother!"

choices.traditional: 寫文章的人比姊姊會餵奶
choices.simplified: 写文章的人比姐姐会喂奶
choices.pinyin: Xiě wénzhāng de rén bǐ jiějie huì wèi nǎi.
choices.english: The writer is better at feeding them than the sister.

questions.why: 這麼說 draws a conclusion from 只有我一看就知道: the writer, there every day after class, knows the twins best. It is a joke, not a sign the sister is bad at it, everyone else found them too alike, and feeding is never compared.
